title: Glaucoma Screening to Enhance At-Risk Californians' Health - Survey Response Incentives
official: Glaucoma Screening to Enhance At-Risk Californians' Health - Survey Response Incentives
summary: This is a randomized trial to assess whether offering a financial incentive will improve the response rate to a telephone survey. Three incentive approaches will be compared: a $5 gift card, entry into a monthly $100 drawing, or no incentive.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

\- Participating in GSEARCH trial

Exclusion Criteria:

\- Patients without a valid phone number
central: Jeremy D Keenan, MD MPH · jeremy.keenan@ucsf.edu
